svg.title: Durable Session Orchestration with customer ACA - proposed request flow
svg.desc: Start or adopt one agent.run in a customer-owned sandbox, supervise it with short polls, request approximately minute-based checkpoint candidates under an unproven capture protocol, then persist and commit the final outcome. No live-process snapshots or per-tool DTS checkpoints are implied.
